name: CASHOUT
summary:
# CASHOUT is FREE forever for Early Access Players! 

Join us as we work to build the best **fast paced, competitive multiplayer shooter in VR!** Inspired by your favorite classic PvP shooters of the last 15 years, become a ruthless agent and fight to become the wealthiest assassin ever known.

Join early access via our Discord (https://discord.gg/dy87XDY5cF)
